create_HarmonicEmbedding: create a HarmonicEmbedding module with configurable harmonic functions and base frequency
run_HarmonicEmbedding_forward: run the HarmonicEmbedding forward pass to convert input tensors into harmonic features
run_HarmonicEmbedding_forward_with_cov: run the HarmonicEmbedding forward pass with diagonal covariance for Gaussian conical frustum approximation
get_HarmonicEmbedding_output_dim: get the output dimension of HarmonicEmbedding for a given input dimension and number of harmonic functions
get_HarmonicEmbedding_output_dim_static: get the output dimension statically using input dimensions, harmonic functions count, and append input flag
